BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1501.name: The MoonlightArtifactDragon Crescenthor
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1501.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
All your "Moonlight"-named Spirits are unaffected by opposing Brave effects.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Blocks)
When this Spirit is destroyed by an opposing 10000 BP or more Spirit via BP comparison, by sending a core from this Spirit to your Trash, this Spirit returns to your Field, refreshed.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11467.name: The MoonlightFairy Gekka
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11467.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
When you are summoning a "Moonlight"-named Spirit card, this Spirit gains two White symbols.

[When Braved] [LV3] (Your Main Step)
When your "Moonlight"-named Spirit is summoned, put a core from the Void to your Life.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12808.name: The SunWyvern Flaredragoon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12808.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the same BP as this Spirit's.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
For each "Sun"-named Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12891.name: The SunCount Rubicante
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12891.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return a "Sun"-named Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing Brave Spirit. Then, the brave of this Spirit remains, and the Spirit alone returns to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12911.name: The SunGiantSoldier Solar-Golem
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12911.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Main Step)
Neither player can summon Braves without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Brave Attacks)
For each "Sun"-named Spirit you control, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
